info.syllabusName: Ngữ âm - Âm vị học (Phonetics - Phonology)
info.description:
This course consists of 10 chapters, providing students with fundamental concepts of English phonetics and phonology. The course commences by presenting 
terminologies relating to speech sounds such as articulators, vowels, consonants, diphthongs and triphthongs 
(chapters 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), and then proceeds to analyze other aspects of connected speech, including stress, linking, assimilation, intonation, strong and weak forms (chapters 6, 7, 8, 9, 10).
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand fundamental notions of phonetics and issues related to phonetics; advanced concepts in English phonology, characteristics of phonology and phonological rules.
Enhance the knowledge and competence in speech sounds to improve their own pronunciation, listening and speaking skilss.
Compare and contrast phonetic units and phonological rules.
Understand values and differences of speech sounds. Besides, this course helps students overcome pronunciation difficulties; and more importantly feel desired to do further researches on languages.
